steps.en: Choose a trading research question and open the README
steps.zh: 选交易研究问题，打开 README

steps.en: Expose method/problem headings through the contents links
steps.zh: 通过目录链接展示方法／问题分类

steps.en: Follow a topic and note candidate papers, authors and years
steps.zh: 进入主题，记录候选论文、作者和年份

steps.en: List separate implementation, data and learning-resource leads
steps.zh: 另列实现、数据与学习资源线索

steps.en: Read original sources and check relevance, freshness and permission
steps.zh: 读原来源，核相关性、时效与许可

value.en: A historical bibliography gives research leads, not a running trading model
value.zh: 历史书目提供研究线索，不提供运行交易模型
